paper_id.description: Opaque positive upstream identifier; not a count or student name.

pass_score.description: Explicit threshold in original score points, for example 60. Omission leaves pass statistics null; no default of 60 is assumed.

max_score.description: Caller-confirmed full score in original points, for example 100. Used only for mean_percent; never inferred from instance.point. Must be positive and at least pass_score when both are supplied.

include_students.description: Include individually ranked students, default false. Summary statistics always cover the full selected cohort.
